title: Tetra-quadric CY Threefold and Assisted Fibre Inflation
summary: In the context of type IIB superstring compactification, we demonstrate the assisted fibre inflation proposal for a four-field model realized using the orientifold of a tetra-quadric Calabi-Yau (CY) threefold. This CY threefold has an underlying permutation symmetry $S_4$ and belongs to both the list of CY threefolds, namely the Kreuzer-Skarke (KS) database as well as the Complete Intersection Calabi-Yau (CICY) database.
